verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp downloads GGUF models via `-hf` flags but contains no discussion of shared cache locations, format compatibility with other runtimes (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio), or explicit reuse-without-reconversion guarantees. missing for 10: documentation on GGUF cache location/sharing, explicit statements about interoperability with other runtimes, evidence of avoiding re-download/re-conversion across tools.
